description: One label per dimension value (chronicle#376). Every fact built from a source package carries the label listed here for a value in dimension_value_labels and, for its groupby value, layout.groupby_value_label; the package's own wording, where it differs, is kept in package_dimension_value_labels. A value enters this register when two or more packages emit it or when its packages word it more than one way. These are Chronicle's display labels, not a publisher's file: a value with one wording keeps it, and a value worded more than one way takes the label chosen in scripts/build_dimension_value_register.py. A package may not declare a different label for a listed value. A value no entry covers takes its package's label, and build-bundle refuses it if two packages label it differently.
